summary: Iteration 5 (backend seed expansion + live GOOGLE_API_KEY) verified end-to-end. USER-REPORTED BUG confirmed fixed: at 430x900, food+Italian reveal card now shows '3 MORE TO CONSIDER' with exactly 3 precise alternative tiles (data-testid=alternative-<id> excluding alternative-sponsored-*). Verified via browser + screenshot on the live preview URL. Extended the iter5 pytest suite: 28/28 pass (seed count exactly 276, 0 duplicate names, expand_seed deterministic across two calls, backend restart x3 idempotent — count stays 276, every (category,cuisine) pair >=4 docs in Mongo, curated fallback path spot-check via subprocess with GOOGLE_API_KEY='' returns >=4 for food/Italian, bars/Beer, desserts/Ice Cream, all generated docs meet quality bar — price in {$,$$,$$$}, rating 4.0-4.9, distance 0.5-28.0, non-sponsored, non-empty name/cuisine/category/description/address/image; the three original sponsors 'Olive & Ember', 'Harborline', 'Ember & Oak BBQ' remain sponsored=true; filter tests exercised against SEED_ALL+apply_filters directly to avoid burning Google quota). Google-live checks: /api/geocode?zip=10001 -> lat 40.7537, lng -73.9992 (within 0.05 of target); POST /api/places/search with category=food/zip=10001 returns source='google' with 20 results and every expected field (name, cuisine, price, rating, distance, lat, lng, image, photo_url, google_url, doordash_url, ubereats_url, grubhub_url, order_url, open_now); GOOGLE_SEARCH_DAILY_CAP env is '300'; db.config {key:'google_budget', date:<today>} field is 'searches' (NOT 'count') — verified that a cache-miss increments 'searches' by 1 and an immediate identical repeat is served from the 5-min cache and does NOT increment. Photo proxy with the key set: /api/places/photo?name=<real photos/... ref from a search> returns 200 image bytes with header X-Photo-Cache: miss on first call and X-Photo-Cache: hit on immediate repeat WITHOUT bumping the search budget counter; malformed name (e.g. 'not-a-valid-photo-ref') still 404s. Three legacy suites re-run: test_iter_fateactions_and_checkin.py, test_iter_sec002_003_004.py, test_iter_ratelimit_isolation.py -> 58 passed, 1 skipped (rate-limit-60/min test can't trigger through ingress IP rewrite), 0 failed. Fixed 2 legacy failures by adding `sys.path.insert(0,'/app/backend')` before `from core import ...` in test_iter_sec002_003_004.py (module resolution only — no app change). FF_BUILD still '2026.06-280' in /app/frontend/public/index.html. Total Google calls consumed for the run: ~10 (well under the 20 budget). Regression signals intact: reveal card fate-actions-trigger dropdown present, order dropdown present for food mode reveal.

action_items: The 'Shuffle the Deck' button in the ZIP screen still has NO data-testid. Adding e.g. testID='deal-button' would remove the get_by_text dependency and speed up all future browser tests (flagged in iter 4 as well).

In db.config the daily Google budget counter field is named 'searches', not 'count'. If any dashboard / admin panel reads 'count', it will silently show 0. Confirm the admin UI and any monitoring/alerting reads doc['searches'].
Optional: normalize rate-limit keying to honor the Cloudflare/ingress client-IP header so /api/checkins 60/min truly enforces per-user, not per-edge-node.
critical_code_review_comments: seed_data.expand_seed uses a per-(category,cuisine) hashlib.md5-seeded Random and a bounded 24-iteration name-template loop; that's genuinely deterministic across restarts and across in-process re-invocations — verified by test_expand_seed_deterministic. Good.

seed_db()'s backfill-by-name path is safe with SEED_ALL because expand_seed is deterministic. If a future change made the generator non-deterministic (e.g. dropped the md5 seed) the backfill would insert fresh dupes on every boot. Consider adding a unique index on db.restaurants.name to make that class of regression a hard failure instead of silent duplication.

The generator sets 'category' explicitly and never marks a doc sponsored=True. TestSeedQuality.test_generated_docs_valid checks this — good. But there's no test guarding that a future edit doesn't accidentally re-key the daily budget field back to 'count'; the JS/Python code should have a single named constant for that key.

rca_of_issue: USER BUG '1 more to consider' → RCA confirmed: preview served curated fallback (no GOOGLE_API_KEY at the time) and 66/69 (category,cuisine) pairs in the old 94-venue seed had 1-2 rows, so RevealStage's `deck.filter(...).slice(0,3)` produced 1 alternative for most cuisines. Two-part fix by the developer: (A) seed_data.expand_seed deterministically tops every (category,cuisine) to MIN_PER_CUISINE=4 → 276 total docs, and (B) live GOOGLE_API_KEY makes /api/places/search hit Google Places (20 results per call). Verified in-browser at 430x900 for food+Italian: alternatives header reads '3 MORE TO CONSIDER' and exactly 3 alternative-<id> tiles render.
